reuse.why: Reuses the existing makeTagAqlRegex for the #fixed tag and one selection function for every action, but setBulkNMonthAvg inlines getCategoryAverage plus the sign flip instead of calling the existing setNMonthAvg (which 6/12-month already used).

duplication.why: Category selection is unified, but the 'income only in tracking budgets' check is still repeated in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and setBulkNMonthAvg, and the average-and-sign logic of setNMonthAvg is copied into setBulkNMonthAvg.

placement.why: Selection lives in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, uses the shared tags module, and the new method is registered alongside its siblings in app.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the four requests; some lines are left unformatted (long lines) and test-only setup is verbose.

maintainability.why: One getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction decides hidden/template/#fixed for every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth through an id set, so a future exclusion lands in one place. The income rule and the average logic are still repeated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setBulkNMonthAvg re-implements setNMonthAvg (getCategoryAverage + income sign) instead of calling it

disguised_duplication.where: setBulkNMonthAvg carries setNMonthAvg's average/sign body under a new name; the income-in-tracking check is phrased as a filter in setLastMonthSpending and as early returns elsewhere

abstraction_drift.where: getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction gained includeHiddenCategories (a SQL '? = 1 OR' branch) for the requested variation; every month-wide action, copyPreviousMonth included, goes through it
